Manage datasets

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/Search-and-Visualize/Partitions](https://docs.bronto.io/Search-and-Visualize/Partitions)
:::

```sh
bronto datasets <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto datasets create`](/reference/commands/datasets/#bronto-datasets-create) | Create a dataset |
| [`bronto datasets delete`](/reference/commands/datasets/#bronto-datasets-delete) | Delete a dataset |
| [`bronto datasets get`](/reference/commands/datasets/#bronto-datasets-get) | Get a dataset by ID |
| [`bronto datasets list`](/reference/commands/datasets/#bronto-datasets-list) | List datasets |
| [`bronto datasets parser`](/reference/commands/datasets/#bronto-datasets-parser) | Show or change the parser assigned to a dataset |
| [`bronto datasets update`](/reference/commands/datasets/#bronto-datasets-update) | Update a dataset |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto datasets create

Create a dataset

```sh
bronto datasets create [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | request body field as key=value; values parse as JSON when possible (repeatable) |
| `--input` |  | string |  | read the request body from a file, or - for stdin |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto datasets create -f collection=<collection> -f dataset=<dataset>
bronto datasets create --input body.json
```

## bronto datasets delete

Delete a dataset

```sh

```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--yes` |  | bool |  | skip the confirmation prompt |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh

```

## bronto datasets parser

Show or change the parser assigned to a dataset

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/core-features/custom-parser](https://docs.bronto.io/core-features/custom-parser)
:::

```sh
bronto datasets parser <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto datasets parser get`](/reference/commands/datasets/#bronto-datasets-parser-get) | Show the parser assigned to a dataset |
| [`bronto datasets parser set`](/reference/commands/datasets/#bronto-datasets-parser-set) | Assign a parser to a dataset |
| [`bronto datasets parser unset`](/reference/commands/datasets/#bronto-datasets-parser-unset) | Remove the parser assignment from a dataset |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto datasets parser get

Show the parser assigned to a dataset

```sh
bronto datasets parser get <dataset> [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto datasets parser get default/nginx
```

## bronto datasets parser set

Assign a parser to a dataset

```sh
bronto datasets parser set <dataset> <parser> [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto datasets parser set default/nginx nginx_combined
```

## bronto datasets parser unset

Remove the parser assignment from a dataset

```sh
bronto datasets parser unset <dataset> [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto datasets parser unset default/nginx
```
